description: This file defines a Java interface 'ReferencePlaceholderResolver' responsible for resolving a field of a referenced entity within the Eclipse Ditto project. It declares a single method for asynchronous resolution involving reference placeholders and headers.

classes.name: ReferencePlaceholderResolver
classes.description: A Java interface for resolving placeholder references asynchronously in the context of Eclipse Ditto. It is parameterized by the type of the value being resolved.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a ReferencePlaceholder into a value of type T, using provided headers.
